name: Helpless Moose 39
author: Cksunandh
description: Gradient dark rounded cyan spinner loader that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(1.1), background changes from radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #575b60 1%, #000000 100%) to radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #373a3d 1%, #000000 100%).
